id: Once Upon a Time in America (1984)

facts.text: Locker 541. The key? Ask the clock.
facts.why: A source confirms the locker key comes from Moe's grandfather clock and the locker is at a train station, but no opened source gives the locker number. The photo looks like a film still showing 541.
facts.fix: Locker at the station. The key? Ask the clock.

facts.text: Music most nights, Cockeye on the flute.
facts.why: No opened source says Cockeye plays an instrument. The record of Amapola played on the gramophone for young Deborah is confirmed.
facts.fix: Music most nights, Amapola on the gramophone.

vibe.verdict: A believable Lower East Side deli with the cake on the stairs, the watch and the locker all in play.
missing: Deborah dancing in the storeroom to Amapola (Moe's back room)
Max's stolen pocket watch coming back at the end (the 1968 party)
Noodles hiding in the opium den (opening and ending)
The garbage truck and the smile in the opium den (final shot)
Bugsy and the young gang on the street (1918)
